title: Episode 2 (lines 512–880)
focus: Jocasta, the three roads and the first fear

teacherSummary.text: Creon defends himself against Oedipus' charge. Jocasta stops the quarrel and, to prove oracles false, tells how Laius was told he would die by his son, how the infant was cast away, and how Laius was killed by robbers where three roads meet. The detail terrifies Oedipus: he tells of leaving Corinth after an oracle that he would kill his father and marry his mother, and of killing an old man and his servants at a crossroads. One hope remains: the surviving witness said "robbers."
